solutions.title: CCTV & Surveillance Systems
solutions.short_description: Design, supply and installation of CCTV for homes, offices, shops and estates, with remote viewing on your phone.
solutions.detailed_description: We survey your site, recommend the right cameras and recorder for your budget, and install everything neatly with proper cabling, power and storage. You get live and recorded footage from anywhere, plus maintenance and support after installation. Suitable for homes, shops, offices, schools, warehouses and estates across Kenya.
features: Free site survey and layout plan
HD and IP cameras with night vision
Live viewing on mobile and PC
Neat cabling, power backup and weatherproofing

solutions.title: Access Control & Biometrics
solutions.short_description: Fingerprint, face and card access, door locks and attendance tracking that control and record who enters.
solutions.detailed_description: Control who can enter which door, and when. We install biometric and card readers, electric locks, intercoms and gate integrations, then connect them to software that records entries and staff attendance. Ideal for offices, apartments, schools, clinics and industrial sites.
features: Fingerprint, face and RFID card readers
Electric door locks and gate integration

solutions.title: Graphic & Brand Design
solutions.short_description: Logos, branding, social media creatives, print and UI/UX design that make your business stand out.
solutions.detailed_description: From a first logo to a complete brand system, we design the visuals your customers see everywhere: social media, print, packaging, websites and apps. Because our designers work alongside our developers, your brand looks consistent from business card to mobile app.
features: Posters, flyers, brochures and company profiles
UI/UX design for websites and apps
Editable source files delivered to you

solutions.title: IT Support & Tech Hardware
solutions.short_description: Networking, Wi-Fi, POS, computers and printers, installed and supported by one tech team.
solutions.detailed_description: We set up and look after the technology your business runs on: office networks and structured cabling, Wi-Fi coverage, point-of-sale systems, computers, printers and more. One team to call when something needs fixing, upgrading or installing.
features: POS systems for shops and restaurants
